subject: Any remaining questions before we close the loop on Redwood discovery?
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Sutherland <tom.sutherland@atlasretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-20T14:12:00-08:00
Subject: Discovery call recap + next steps

Hi Tom —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap of what we covered and the bits I promised to send:

- Current pain: latency spikes on batch inference during peak hours and unpredictable cost per inference.
- What we demoed: Redwood Dedicated with autoscaled pools + prefix KV caching; typical latency gains of 30–60% depending on model.
- Success metrics you mentioned: 95th percentile latency under 300ms and cost per 1k inferences under $X (approx).

Attachments: redwood-discovery-recap.pdf (slide highlights), ATLR-mutual-action-plan.xlsx (draft timeline).

Near-term options I suggested:
1) 2-week pilot on a small reserved pool (proof of latency & unit cost) — estimated start: Dec 6.
2) Short eval with a performance-runbook and benchmarks we run on your sample dataset.

Can you confirm which path you prefer and whether Dec is still realistic for Atlas Retail’s Q4–Q1 budget window? If there are stakeholders I should loop in (infra, procurement), reply-all and I’ll add a short FAQ doc.

Want to keep this tight — if helpful I can propose two calendar slots for a 15-min alignment next week.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0192

On Fri, Nov 20, 2026 at 13:05 Tom Sutherland <tom.sutherland@atlasretail.com> wrote:
> Thanks Camila— appreciated the walkthrough. I’ll share the dataset pointers with Eng.
>
> —Tom
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-27T09:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Discovery call recap + next steps

Tom —

Following up on the note below. I haven't heard back and wanted to check if there are any remaining questions on fit, or if timelines/budget shifted on your side.

Short ask: could you share one of the following this week?
- Quick thumbs up on pilot (I’ll send a short SOW + calendar options)
- A no-go note (helps us close the loop)
- A date when procurement/infra might be available for a quick sync

If it helps, I attached a 1-page FAQ that covers common procurement and data isolation questions.

Appreciate any signal — even a one-line reply is helpful.

Best,
Camila

Attachments: redwood-procurement-faq.pdf
From: Tom Sutherland <tom.sutherland@atlasretail.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-29T09:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Discovery call recap + next steps

Camila —

Apologies for the radio silence. We had an internal budget shuffle and are deprioritizing new pilots until Jan. That said, two quick items:

1) Can you send a ballpark number for a 2-week pilot (reserved pool + 1 model) so I can tuck it into our FY planning? Rough order of magnitude is fine.
2) We’re still interested; can you ping me again in mid-Jan to revisit timing? 

Thanks,
Tom
